cases.input: A Python static analyzer reports duplicate methods but misses an unused class assignment overwritten by a same-name method. The analyzer has definition and assignment binding types and an unused-redefinition diagnostic.
cases.reason: The public symptom and semantic binding model match the supported mechanism.

cases.input: A user reports that an attribute disappears after a function definition, but provides no analyzer code, diagnostic policy, or public reproduction.
cases.reason: Request public context or perform read-only inspection; do not assume the definition-side owner or policy.

cases.input: A Python analyzer allows log = get_logger(); log = log.bind(user=user), and the requested change is to reject all repeated assignments.
cases.reason: Ordinary assignment rebinding is outside the repair and must retain existing policy.

cases.input: An application wants runtime prevention of obj.name = value overwriting an existing object attribute.
cases.reason: This Workflow concerns static binding redefinition, not runtime mutation controls.
